title: Security, Resilience & Deployment Readiness
scope: SignalForge Phase 10 — frozen-model forward validation on new public data; security, resilience, deployment readiness only; no live orders, no retraining, no tuning, no calibration

critical_findings: T1.1: No API authentication on read-only endpoints (anyone can query /api/v1)
T2.1: Unsafe pickle deserialization in model registry (arbitrary code execution on load)
high_findings: T3.1: Real API key committed in .env (META_MUSE_API_KEY)
T7.1: --fail-open flag not gated behind environment variable

fixes: Added get_api_token() and verify_api_token() to crypto_engine.api.security (reads SIGNALFORGE_API_TOKEN env var)
Added Bearer token auth middleware to crypto_engine.api.app.create_app() (skips auth when no token configured)
Replaced pickle deserialization with JSON-only in crypto_engine.registry.store._serialize_model/_deserialize_model
Gated --fail-open behind SIGNALFORGE_ALLOW_FAIL_OPEN=1 env var in crypto_engine.cli.signal_generate
Added secret label redaction to crypto_engine.observability.metrics._label_string (sk-, Bearer, api_key patterns redacted to REDACTED)
Removed real API key from .env (META_MUSE_API_KEY= placeholder only)
Disabled Meta Muse AI provider in config/default.toml (enabled = false)
Set non-empty egress_allowlist (api.meta.ai) for defense in depth

features: BackupManifest pydantic model with SHA-256 checksums per file
create_backup() — backs up registry, data, paper state, logs with 50MB per-file cap
restore_from_backup() — dry-run default, atomic restore with checksum verification
retention_cleanup() — keeps N most recent backups

pre_existing_failure_categories: 6 x SyntaxError U+FEFF (BOM in source files)
1 x import boundary violation (routes.py imports observability.health)
1 x AI CLI config test (not_configured without --live)

conclusion: Q10 Phase A-F complete. All CRITICAL and HIGH security findings remediated. Backup/restore, deployment checklist, rollback runbook, and package verification implemented. 1354 tests passing, 8 pre-existing failures unrelated to Q10 changes. Deployment does NOT authorize live trading or real-money orders.
